item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
Manipur security forces seized a Kuki-Zo insurgent camp, arrested suspects accused of impersonating SoO cadres and recovered firearms, grenades and ammunition, while chief minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh linked the violence to a pervasive gun culture and urged surrender of illegal arms. The Kashmir IGP called for action against over-ground workers and hybrid terrorists, urging a more intelligence-driven police approach. Congress legislators demanded the resignation of the Manipur chief minister, fresh elections and dissolution of the assembly. The UCDP recorded 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
